newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Nestle says H2 sales show rising trend.
newsitem.headline: Nestle says H2 sales show rising trend.

text.p: Nestle SA said its sales appeared to be turning higher in the second half of 1996.
In October alone, sales were up 12 percent versus October 1995, Nestle chairman Helmut Maucher said at a news conference to present 10-month results.
In general, he said "a slight increase in sales in the second half of the year" could be seen.
Nonetheless, he said that sales so far have not developed in a "completely satisfying" manner.
He said that for the first time in a few years, however, exchange rates had had a positive impact on Nestle's results.
The Swiss franc has eased against key export currencies, especially the German mark and the U.S. dollar, since September after a prolonged period of appreciation. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
